text: 好敏感的问题…
en: Such a sensitive issue...

text: 我看了题主的问题描述，关于卖淫合法化可以降低强奸案的犯罪率，这一点我表示存疑的。
en: I read the questioner's description of the problem, and I have my doubts about the claim that legalising prostitution could lower the crime rate for rape cases.

text: 以我国目前的性开放度，确实有一部分单身的会有性需求，但也很少有憋到非犯罪不可的地步。
en: Given the current level of sexual openness in our country, it is true that some single people have sexual needs, but very few are so frustrated that they are driven to commit a crime.

text: 一部分单身人士，虽然没有固定的伴侣，但是偶尔一个炮友还是会有的…
en: Some single people, though they have no fixed partner, will occasionally have a fuck buddy...

text: 类似工地上的那种临时夫妻，现在并不少见，我有个老朋友，以前就遇到过类似的，还是女方主动的，拒绝跟他正式恋爱，但可以发生关系…
en: Temporary couples of the kind found on construction sites are not uncommon nowadays. I have an old friend who encountered something similar before - it was the woman who made the first move; she refused to have a proper relationship with him but was willing to have sex...

text: 说白了，她也有生理需求，找个自己有点感觉，又不完全看得上的做临时搭子，这种事儿真不少见。
en: To put it plainly, she also had physical needs; finding someone she felt a bit of a spark with but did not fully fancy, to be a temporary partner - such things are truly not rare.

text: 我曾经跟一个女性律师朋友讨论过这个问题，当时我问的问题就是卖淫合法化。
en: I once discussed this issue with a female lawyer friend; the question I asked her at the time was the legalisation of prostitution.

text: 起因是她接到了一个被控卖淫的案子，于是乎我们就讨论起了关于卖淫合法的问题。
en: The reason was that she had taken on a case involving a charge of prostitution, and so we ended up discussing whether prostitution should be legal.

text: 这位律师朋友是这么回答我的，她说：
en: This lawyer friend answered me as follows; she said:

text: 身为女性，她是不支持卖淫合法化的，从女性角度她无法接受这个，但是站在律师的角度，她又认为这是个可进可出的问题。
en: As a woman, she did not support the legalisation of prostitution; from a female perspective she could not accept it, but standing in her capacity as a lawyer, she felt it was a matter that could go either way.

text: 首先她认为合法化，不能有效的降低强奸案犯罪率，为什么呢，她说她接触过的强奸案件里，有很大一部分并不是单身的。
en: First, she believed that legalisation could not effectively lower the rape crime rate. Why? She said that among the rape cases she had dealt with, a large portion did not involve single people.

text: 这些犯人很多都是有女朋友，乃至有老婆的，甚至连孩子都有了的。
en: Many of these offenders had girlfriends, even wives, and some even had children.

text: 从生理角度上来说，他们并不缺少性生活，也完全达不到性需求强烈的程度，然而这些都会犯强奸罪。
en: Physiologically speaking, they were not lacking in sex life, nor did they reach a level of intense sexual need, yet these people still committed rape.

text: 这些人里有些纯粹的就是坏，还有一部分人是追求刺激，是的，你没看错，就是追求刺激。
en: Among these people, some were simply bad; another portion were chasing thrills - yes, you read that right, they were chasing thrills.

text: 有些犯人常规的性生活已经满足不了他们，他们想通过这种行为来获得刺激。
en: Some offenders could no longer be satisfied by conventional sex life; they wanted to obtain thrills through this kind of behaviour.

text: 她还说，在目前卖淫打击力度如此大的前提下，原本的明娼大部分都转为了暗娼。
en: She also said that, given the current intense crackdown on prostitution, most of the former open prostitutes had turned into covert prostitutes.

text: 虽然国家打击力度非常大，但基本上不太可能做到完全杜绝的，她说未来一定会有很多变种的卖淫方式，方法总比困难多…
en: Although the state's crackdown is very severe, it is basically impossible to eradicate it completely. She said that in the future there will certainly be many variant forms of prostitution - where there's a will there's a way...

text: 严厉的打击力度，必然会催生出各种变种的卖淫方式。
en: A harsh crackdown will inevitably give rise to various variant forms of prostitution.

text: 这一点，我认为她确实说对了，最近这几年游戏援、外卖援、还有各种XX援，证明了她的判断是正确的。
en: On this point, I think she was indeed right. In recent years, 'game escorts', 'takeaway escorts', and various other 'XX escorts' have proven her judgement correct.

text: 随后她说，从这个角度来看，其实有条件的开放，定期体检，似乎反而是更容易管控的，至少能很大程度上减少性病的传播。
en: She then said that, looking at it from this angle, a conditional opening-up, with regular health checks, actually seems easier to regulate, and at the very least could greatly reduce the spread of sexually transmitted diseases.

text: 从利弊方面来说，似乎开放和不开放都有好处和坏处，这不仅仅是满足单身人群的性需求问题。
en: In terms of pros and cons, it seems both opening up and not opening up have benefits and drawbacks; this is not merely a question of satisfying the sexual needs of single people.

text: 因为单身人群的性需求是可以有其他方式来满足的，并非必须用这个途径。
en: Because the sexual needs of single people can be met through other means; this route is not a necessity.

text: 综合下来，她个人认为，禁止卖淫的益处是要优于坏处的。
en: On balance, her personal view was that the benefits of prohibiting prostitution outweigh the drawbacks.

text: 她还说，她接触过不少关于组织容留卖淫的案件，至少从她接触的这些相关案犯和失足女的经验来看，目前的失足女可以说九成以上都是自愿的，并不存在强迫的问题。
en: She also said she had handled quite a few cases involving the organisation of, and providing premises for, prostitution. At least from her experience with the relevant offenders and fallen women she had encountered, over ninety per cent of today's fallen women are voluntary, and there is no issue of coercion.

text: 当然，也确实有被强迫的，但更多的是自愿从事性工作的，正是基于这个点，她认为要完全杜绝卖淫嫖娼就更加的困难，几乎是个不可能完成的任务。
en: Of course, there are indeed those who are forced, but more are engaging in sex work voluntarily. Precisely because of this, she believed that completely eradicating prostitution and soliciting becomes even harder, almost an impossible task.

text: 我另外一个朋友，还在这个问题上表达另外一个想法，他认为卖淫合法化，可能会有一个潜在的风险。
en: Another friend of mine also expressed a different view on this issue: he believed that the legalisation of prostitution might carry a potential risk.

text: 那就是从一定程度上降低年轻人的结婚意愿，或者说会延后结婚生育的时间。
en: That is, to a certain extent it could lower young people's willingness to marry, or rather, it could delay the time of marriage and childbearing.

text: 从这方面来说，大量开放卖淫，可能会影响生育率，这一点我个人不发表意见。
en: From this angle, widely opening up prostitution could affect the birth rate; on this point I shall offer no personal opinion.

text: 我不是人口专家，这个点只是转述，并不是我的意见，当然他也说了，这是个潜在风险，未必是真风险。
en: I am not a population expert; this point is merely relayed, not my own view. Of course, he also said it is a potential risk and not necessarily a real one.

text: 本王就是装逼界第一天王，知乎瓦萨比，逼乎柯镇恶，喷人大帝，知乎喷神，纸糊叶圣陶，文坛先知，网文拖拉机，不是在喷人，就是在喷人的路上，自号江苏第一狠人，姑苏扛把子，知乎警察局，阅读纪检委，吐槽小王子，怼人天王，立志把自己活成一个段子的奇男子。
en: This king is the number one king of the show-off world, Zhihu Wasabi, Bihu Zhen'e Ke, the Great Emperor of Flames, the Zhihu Flame God, Paper-mache Shengtao Ye, the Prophet of the Literary World, the Web-novel Tractor, either flaming people or on the way to flaming people, self-styled as Jiangsu's number one ruthless man, the chief of Gusu, the Zhihu Police Station, the Reading Discipline Inspection Commission, the Little Prince of Roasts, the Heavenly King of Retorts, a remarkable man determined to live his life as a punchline.

text: 没法反驳，因为现在风气已经魔幻了，昨天就和个女的对线，张口闭口就是男性无法生育，就得因为后代给女性做牛做马，甚至于孩子也应该跟女姓，这是女性对男性的性施舍。
en: There is no way to refute it, because the atmosphere nowadays has become surreal. Just yesterday I was sparring with a woman, and she kept saying that men cannot give birth, so they must slave away for women for the sake of the offspring; she even claimed children should take the woman's surname - this is women's sexual alms to men.

text: 你看如今已经魔幻到了这个地步，某种垄断令她们越来越飘。
en: Look how surreal things have become nowadays; a certain kind of monopoly is making them increasingly arrogant.

text: 最大的论点就是强迫和自愿，那也非常简单，和烟草一个样，杜绝私营，一切有上方管控，增加税率比例就行了，至于上方强迫女性，那我就不说了
en: The biggest argument is coercion versus voluntariness, and that is very simple - just like tobacco: eradicate private operation, let everything be under the control of the authorities above, and raise the tax-rate proportion; as for the authorities above coercing women, I shall say no more.

text: 有一年孤身走暗巷，
en: One year, I walked alone down a dark alley,

text: 一位四十多岁的大姐笑眯眯的对我说，哥，想不想爽一爽？
en: A woman in her forties said to me with a beaming smile, 'Bro, wanna have a bit of fun?'

text: 我想拒绝，
en: I wanted to refuse,

text: 她却说，母女服务，只算你一个人的价！
en: but she said, 'Mother-daughter service - we'll only charge you for one person!'

text: 我喜出望外，答应了。
en: I was overjoyed and agreed.

text: 跟着她到她家，
en: I followed her to her home,

text: 她喊了一句，
en: and she called out,

text: 妈，出来接客了！
en: 'Mum, come out to receive customers!'

text: 我在另外一个回答里
en: In another of my answers

text: 说的比较清楚了，对于色情行业的伦理学问题归根结底就是对以下两个问题的回答：
en: I explained it fairly clearly: the ethical question of the sex industry ultimately comes down to answering the following two questions:

text: 首先，性器官或者性特征是否有与人的其他身体器官或特征在道德上的本质不同，以至于通过性器官或特征赚钱天然就比通过四肢/脑力等其他器官赚钱来的不道德？
en: First, do sexual organs or sexual characteristics differ essentially, in moral terms, from a person's other bodily organs or characteristics, such that earning money through sexual organs or characteristics is naturally more immoral than earning money through other organs such as the limbs or the brain?

text: 其次，在进行经济活动组织的时候，是性器官相关的工作啊不道德/不能合法化是因为它极容易受到黑恶势力的控制？
en: Second, when organising economic activity, is work related to sexual organs immoral, or unable to be legalised, because it is extremely susceptible to control by criminal forces?

text: 还是它受到黑恶势力的控制恰恰只是因为它长期被看做是不道德/违法的？
en: Or is it that it is controlled by criminal forces precisely because it has long been regarded as immoral or illegal?

text: 前一个问题涉及对于人体的伦理学基本立场，后一个问题则是关于色情业违法/不道德与黑恶势力控制真正的因果关系是什么。
en: The former question touches on the basic ethical stance towards the human body; the latter is about what the true causal relationship is between the sex industry's illegality or immorality and control by criminal forces.

text: 而个人看来，要想做出题主所需要的强反驳，必须对于两个问题都持肯定态度。
en: In my personal view, to make the strong refutation the questioner needs, one must answer both questions in the affirmative.

text: 即一方面认为人体器官以及工作方式存在天然的道德优劣，并且基于这种道德上的劣性会导致黑恶势力的染指。
en: That is, on the one hand, one must believe that human organs and ways of working possess a natural moral hierarchy, and that this moral inferiority leads to encroachment by criminal forces.

text: 而真正能做出这样的反驳的只有文化保守主义。
en: And the only position that can truly make such a refutation is cultural conservatism.

text: 同样之前的回答一样，我不会否认文化保守主义的合理性，文化保守主义并不会因为“保守”就天然不正确。
en: As with my previous answer, I will not deny the reasonableness of cultural conservatism; cultural conservatism is not inherently wrong simply because it is 'conservative'.

text: 相反，我真心希望在诸如色情业，代孕，开放性行为，基因技术等方面都持负面态度的人都能自觉本身的保守主义立场。
en: On the contrary, I sincerely hope that those who hold a negative attitude towards things such as the sex industry, surrogacy, open sexual behaviour, and genetic technology will recognise their own conservative stance.

text: 这对于国内键政圈子常年张冠李戴的现象都会是很好的修正。
en: This would be a good correction to the long-standing phenomenon of misattribution in the domestic keyboard-politics circles.

text: 一个社会必然存在左中右，更何况是中国这样超大型，内部差异性极大的社会。
en: Any society necessarily contains left, centre, and right; all the more so for a society as vast as China, with its enormous internal differences.

text: 存在文化保守主义一点不奇怪，没有劳保才奇怪。
en: The existence of cultural conservatism is not strange at all; it would be strange if there were no old guard.

text: 同样地，舆论场也需要充分保证保守主义者的发言权利。
en: Similarly, the public opinion sphere also needs to adequately guarantee the right of conservatives to speak.
